desc_en: A refined silhouette that redefines urban functionality. The Imperial Velvet backpack features an immaculate all-over print design, conceived for those who demand distinction in every journey. Its streamlined aesthetic merges with a versatile and resilient structure. Each piece is meticulously crafted to order in our ateliers. We offer worldwide shipping to meet the expectations of the most discerning clientele.
